title: When the Uniform Wakes
author: Dominic Okafor
blurb: Juniper Almeida, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the ice breaks on the river.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
